_comment: Backup Check catalog. Installed to /boot/config/plugins/backupcheck/catalog.json on first install; edit that copy, not this one. See README.md for the schema.

summary._comment: The daily summary file is saved on the flash drive, and also in a 'Backup Summary' folder on each of these locations.

pool.name: Cachebackup
pool.note: A separate pool from appdata, so it survives a cache failure. Holds most daily copies and the monthly archives.

d10.name: Disk10
d10.note: Protected by parity. A second, separate drive for appdata.

media.name: Media share
media.note: Protected by parity. Holds the raw MySQL copies (and old monthly archives from before).

files.name: FilesBackup
files.note: Not shared on the network. Holds the Appdata Backup plugin's nightly sets, Nextcloud and Ruizdocs.

ntfs.name: NTFS-Backup
ntfs.note: Not shared on the network. The second drive for Nextcloud and Ruizdocs, and the rebuild kit.

cache.name: Cache
cache.note: Same drive as appdata: reports kept here also travel inside the appdata backups.

abp.name: Appdata Backup (plugin)
abp.label: Nightly Snapshots
notes: info
Stops each container, archives and verifies it, then starts it again. Keeps 10 nights. Also saves the flash drive and every container template in each night's set.
